focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: From Arrays to Evidence: Building a Reproducible Visualization Workflow
utility_title: csv-visualize: Labeled CSV plots from the command line
utility_use_case: A researcher receives a CSV export of paired sensor readings and wants a quick visual check before deciding whether the dataset merits deeper analysis. `csv-visualize` can create a labeled scatter plot in an automated, headless workflow and print counts of included and omitted rows. The saved chart supports inspection and communication, while the explicit omission count helps the researcher notice data-quality issues. The plot remains descriptive: it cannot establish that one measurement causes another or supply inferential results.
